v1.9The big one

A phone in your pocket, buses on the streets, a bank that keeps your money safe, and your game finally saves.

📱Your phone (P)A smartphone slides up on the right. Messages lets you text any player online, privately.
🏦myBANKPut money in the bank from your phone. It stays safe when you’re wasted or busted.
💾Your game savesCash, bank, guns, armor and safehouses are kept when you refresh or leave the page.
🚌BusesCity buses full of passengers stop at bus stops. Hold one up with a gun for the passengers’ cash.
🚗Ride togetherOnline, press F next to another player’s car to ride in the passenger seat.
💥Car fightsShoot players in their cars (it wrecks the car too) and crash into each other like any other car.
💬Chat settingsTurn chat off completely, or censor swear words. Both in Settings.
🏙️Busier citiesMore people, café tables, food carts and people waiting for the bus. No more rain indoors.

Patch notes

v1.9.1The subwayLatest
  • The subway: every city has an underground station. Look for the green-lit SUBWAY pavilion on the pavement with the city's name on it (a T on the map) and press E to go down.
  • Each station has two platforms with the tracks between them. A train comes into each platform once a minute: it brakes in out of the tunnel, the doors slide open, a chime plays, the doors close and it pulls out. The boards show where each platform goes and when the next train is due.
  • Walk in through the open doors and stay on board: 20 seconds later you're at the next city's station. Platform 1 runs San Varro → Harbor City → Port Bellmore → North Point → Redwood → Silver Lake → Cedar Falls → Isla Verde and back round; Platform 2 goes the other way.
  • Press E at the stairs to go up to the street in whichever city you're in, or at the passage at the other end to cross to the other platform.
v1.9Phone, buses and saving
  • The phone: press P and a smartphone slides up on the right (phones and tablets: the Phone button). Press P or Esc to put it away.
  • Messages: online, open Messages, pick a player and text them privately. Only they see it. New messages pop up and show a red badge on the app.
  • myBANK: put money in the bank and take it out from the phone. Money in myBANK stays safe when you’re wasted or busted. You can’t deposit while the police are after you.
  • Your game saves: cash, myBANK, guns and ammo, armor, grenades, your safehouses and what’s in them are saved every few seconds and when you refresh or leave the page, online and offline. Resetting your profile also deletes the save.
  • Buses: city buses with passengers inside drive the streets and stop at bus stops on the way, where people get on and off. Walk up to one with a gun out and press E to rob the passengers ($250 to $650, and the police come).
  • Online, ride together: press F next to another player’s car to get in the passenger seat. You sit beside them on both screens; F gets you out.
  • Online, shooting players in cars now works properly: you see sparks, they take damage, and their car takes damage too until it blows up.
  • Online, car crashes: two players’ cars now crash into each other like any other car, and traffic bumps into other players’ cars too. You can’t walk through them any more.
  • Settings → Turn off chat: hides the chat and phone messages completely. You can’t send or see any until you turn it back on. Censor chat turns swear words, sexual words and insults into ****. Both are off unless you turn them on.
  • Busier cities: café tables, newspaper boxes, planters, food carts, bike racks and phone boxes on the pavements, more bus stops, people waiting for the bus, and more people and traffic downtown.
  • Rain no longer falls inside shops, the bank, the mall or buildings.
  • The Secret Service now gives you 8 minutes to pay off your debt (it was 2).
  • Online spawn protection lasts 15 seconds (it was 10).
v1.8.5Chat
  • T opens the chat while you're online, now also while you're waiting to respawn. A small T Chat hint sits above the chat so everyone knows.
  • Pressing T offline tells you chat is for online play.
  • Phones and tablets: a Chat button in the bottom bar when you're online.
v1.8.4Players and map
  • Hold Tab to see everyone who's playing online: their names, whether they're on foot, driving or down, and how far away they are. Offline it just says it's you.
  • M now opens the full map screen, the same one as Pause → Map: zoom, drag around and set a route. Press M or Esc to close it and you're straight back in the game.
v1.8.3See everyone
  • Fixed: online, players could stop seeing each other. Everyone's position goes through the first player in, and that stopped whenever they paused, opened a shop, watched a cutscene or switched to another tab. It now keeps going no matter what they're doing.
  • Every other player now shows on the big map (M) and the map screen too, as a blue dot with their name, moving as they move. They were only on the minimap before.
v1.8.2One sky
  • Online, everyone's time of day is synced to the minute: the same sunrise, the same night, the same clock in the corner.
  • Online, the weather is synced too: when it rains for one player, it rains for everyone.
v1.8.1Online first
  • Play online is now the top button on the menu, with a Recommended badge.
  • Play is now Play offline. It tells you offline isn’t recommended, then asks if you’re sure, because online is the better, more supported mode.
  • The Profile button on the left is gone: open your profile with the card in the top right corner.
  • Fixed: the big update splash and the version number still said 1.6.1. They show the newest version now.
  • Online: drive into another player and they go ragdoll flying (and get hurt), just like people on the street.
  • Online: 10 seconds of spawn protection when you join and every time you respawn. You flicker while it lasts, and attacking someone ends it early.
v1.8Chat
  • Online chat: press T, type, and press Enter to talk to everyone in the online city. Esc cancels. Messages show above the minimap.
v1.7.1Online fights
  • Fixed: punches and knife slashes didn’t hurt other players online (you start with your gun put away, so a click is a punch). Now they do.
  • Grenades and cars you blow up hurt other players near them too.
  • Other players are a little easier to hit with a gun.
v1.7Play online
  • New on the main menu: Play online. Everyone who presses it is in the same San Varro.
  • See the other players walk, run and drive, with their name over their head, and find them on your minimap as blue dots.
  • Shoot them: your bullets hurt other players, headshots do more, and shots into their car hurt the driver. When someone goes down, everyone sees who took them out (+25 XP for you).
  • Up to 16 players at once. You start next to the hospital, with the same rifle, knife and $2,500 as always. Traffic, people on the street and the police are your own.
v1.6.2Lottery closed
  • The lottery has been removed. Lottery tickets are still on the shelf at grocery stores, but they're under construction and no longer available to buy.
  • Fixed: you could lose your wanted stars just by standing outside the store you'd robbed, before the police even arrived. The police now search where you were last seen, so you have to get away from there (or out of sight once they're on you) to lose them.
v1.6.1The big fix update
  • The Strait Bridge: the concrete piers no longer poke up through the road on the island side, and the road from Interstate 1 to the bridge is finally paved (it used to be grass).
  • Houses and offices: walk out through the door to leave (you used to fall out into an empty world behind the room). The people who live and work inside now stay there instead of vanishing.
  • If you hide in a building while you’re wanted, the police break the door down after 10 seconds and come in after you.
  • Walk-in shops have big glass windows, so you can see the shelves and the clerk from the street, and much more inside: tiled floors, aisles of products, a drinks fridge, a second checkout, display cases and gun racks.
  • City storefronts (cafés, sushi bars, bakeries and the rest) show their inside through the window instead of a dark wall.
  • The bank: marble floor, columns, desks, a queue, and a vault room in the back. Rob the bank and the manager hands you the key to the back; open the vault for $5,000.
  • Every robbery (shops, storefronts, the bank, safes and jewelry boxes) has a 4-minute cooldown, and tells you how long is left.
  • Police see 30% less: their vision cones are 30% narrower and 30% shorter.
  • A limit on police for each wanted level: 1 star is one car with 2 officers, 2 stars up to 4 officers, 3 stars up to 5, and 4 or 5 stars up to 8 plus the helicopter.
  • The Secret Service: they arrive 2 minutes after you fall into debt, one car at a time, and they’re weaker. They no longer wait for you when you respawn, and shooting them doesn’t give you stars or bring the police.
v1.6Open for business
  • Every closed storefront in the cities and towns is now a real shop: café, pizza, barber, deli, pharmacy, burgers, diner, books, laundry, sushi, tacos, gym, flowers, hotel, bakery and noodles.
  • Press B at any shop to buy. The clerk comes to the counter for a short scene, then a menu opens with that shop’s items. B also works at gun stores and grocery stores.
  • Press E at a storefront to rob it, with its own robbery scene.
  • Sushi costs $20 and bread at the bakery is free. Food and drinks heal you and give a speed boost for a minute (you run 20% faster and slowly heal). The boost shows under the clock.
  • Other shops: medicine at the pharmacy, a workout at the gym (+20 armor), books for XP, a hotel room that heals you and skips to the morning.
  • Fixed: NPC drivers’ heads poked through the roofs of their cars. Drivers now fit inside every car.
v1.5.1Police balance
  • Half as many police: half as many police cars in normal traffic, and when you’re wanted the police send half as many cars, half as often.
  • The police are 30% slower than you: police cars top out at 70% of the average car you can drive, and cops on foot run at 70% of your sprint.
  • Tested from start to finish: driving, police chases, shops, robberies, buildings and respawning.
v1.5The cutscene update
  • New opening: close-up shots, you tell the guards what you really think, and they throw you in a dumpster outside the gate. You climb out and the game starts.
  • Cutscenes at the gun store and grocery stores when you buy, and when you rob a store, the mall or the bank.
  • Grocery stores sell snacks, meals and lottery tickets. Take out a gun before pressing E to rob one instead.
  • Profile: your name (used whenever you talk in a cutscene), levels and XP, stats, and outfits to unlock that you wear in the game.
  • Fewer cars in the outer towns and the countryside. Downtown San Varro keeps its traffic.
  • This list of past patch notes.
v1.4.2Camera tweaks
  • 75% fewer speed cameras.
  • A longer camera cutscene: a 3 second flash, then more talk at the police station.
v1.4.1Speed cameras
  • Speed cameras on traffic lights and buildings in the towns and cities.
  • Speed limits on every road, shown next to your speedometer: 50 in town, 80 on country roads, 90 on the bridge, 110 on the highway.
  • A warning when you speed towards a camera.
  • Caught on camera: a cutscene with your photo on a police desk, then the police come after you, and the road you’re on is cleared of traffic until you turn off it.
  • An update popup and a What’s new button.
v1.4A much bigger world
  • A world 7× bigger, with forests, farms and homes all the way between the towns.
  • The huge Redwood Forest, and four new towns: Harbor City, Silver Lake, North Point and Redwood.
  • A giant red suspension bridge across the strait to the island town of Isla Verde.
  • Touch controls for phones and tablets.
  • Ultra graphics: filmic colour, wider sharper shadows, grass and glossier cars.
  • New engine sounds with gear changes and tyre squeal, and menu music.
  • Fixes: no more grass on the roads, and a hood view instead of the steering wheel poking through the car.
v1.3Day, night and a bigger city
  • A world 4× bigger: Port Bellmore, Cedar Falls and an outer highway.
  • Day and night (5 minutes each): lit windows, street lamps and headlights. Random rain, with wipers on every car.
  • Walk into office towers, warehouses and houses, and rob the safe or jewelry box inside.
  • Rent a safehouse for $1,000 to keep guns and cash safe when you die.
  • Can’t pay the hospital? You go into debt and the Secret Service hunts you until it’s paid.
  • Car radio with 3 stations, a driver view, a knife, punching, map routes, traffic lights, and you start with $2,500.
v1.2Carjacking
  • Carjacking: you drag the driver out before you drive off.
  • Police see in a cone in front of them, shown on the minimap.
  • Many more homes and trees across the countryside and Westbrook.
  • Fixed: the hospital bill and bail now come off the cash shown on screen.
v1.1A busier San Varro
  • 3× the traffic and far more people.
  • Big crashes throw you out of the car instead of killing you.
  • Gun stores with 10 guns and grenades.
  • San Varro Mall, with registers to rob.
  • A denser city and countryside, a cleaner HUD, and your gun stays holstered until you press 1.
v1.0Release day
  • The first version: walk out of San Varro State Penitentiary into the city.
  • Steal cars, rob stores and the Union Vault Bank, and buy guns.
  • Wanted levels up to 5 stars, with police cars and a helicopter.

Settings

Turn off chat removes the online chat and phone messages from your game: you can’t send or see any until you turn it back on. Censor chat turns swear words, sexual words and insults into ****. Both only change your own game.

Quality sets resolution, shadows, traffic, pedestrians and tree density. Ultra adds filmic colour, sharper shadows over a wider area, grass and glossier cars.
